transformations.description: Copies all twelve published Line 5/6 ordered sections independently. No reverse pattern, branch concatenation or cross-pattern handoff edge is generated.
Copies 20 accepted Cartagena StopNode/StopPlace identities exactly from prior accepted scenarios.
Uses official operator-linked map/directions coordinates for 86 newly created identities; these are Grade C, not surveyed platform geometry.
Derives only package-local center/bounds while preserving accepted es-cartagena settlement canonical fields exactly.

warnings: The project label legacy is a scenario-family label; this package models the current published snapshot captured on 2026-08-13.
Line 5 La Vaguada, Los Gabatos, El Plan and UCAM alternatives are source-distinct and are not flattened into one maximal sequence.
Line 6 Urbanización Buenos Aires workings are retained separately from the Molinos Marfagones pair.
Distinct operator codes with identical/similar rider-facing names are not merged; operator code remains the identity key.
StopNode.sourceReferences are empty for all new identities because no genuine OpenStreetMap node/way was reconciled.
Published spelling such as SANJ UAN BOSCO SALESIANOS is preserved from the official stop page rather than silently corrected.
Later Cartagena components must reuse every shared accepted StopNode/StopPlace object from this scenario exactly.
